extracted.intended_audience: banking industry professionals, ABA members, bank policy/advocacy staff, and member association partners
extracted.subtask_short: legislative and regulatory advocacy for banks
extracted.subtask_description: Overview/landing page describing the American Bankers Association's advocacy priorities, channels for engagement, and topical issue areas where the ABA advocates before Congress, regulators, and courts. It is a high-level navigation/summary page rather than a procedural how-to or rulebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy scope
rubrics_metrics.description: ABA advocates for banks before Congress, the regulatory agencies and the courts to drive pro-growth policies that help customers, clients and communities thrive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames where ABA conducts advocacy (legislative, regulatory, judicial) and the stated purpose (pro-growth policies benefiting customers, clients and communities). No procedural detail on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusive & Equitable Growth

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a pillar of messaging/priority; no further detail on this landing page.
